hooks.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}") && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2]); import store; store.STORE_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True); (store.STORE_DIR/'.current_repo').write_text(sys.argv[1]); print(json.dumps(store.get_session_start_context(sys.argv[1])))" "$REPO" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
echo '{"systemMessage": "Contexer: context compaction starting — call update_context for any decisions not yet stored"}'

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}") && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2]); import store; ctx=store.get_context(sys.argv[1]); print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Contexer: context reloaded after compaction\n' + ctx}))" "$REPO" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}") && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2]); import store; result=store.get_bootstrap_context_prompt(sys.argv[1]); print(json.dumps(result))" "$REPO" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
